title: Template check: the app hears an out-of-tune passage
problem: Not a real idea. This record exists to check that a second proposal produces the same sections and timings as the first, and that the demo kit's scripted audio makes the app react to an out-of-tune passage the same way every time.

evidence.quote_or_summary: The README describes the app as listening through the microphone and saying, note by note, whether each note was played right.

hypothesis: Scripted microphone input with a high second finger makes the results flag both F sharps as sharp.
acceptance_criteria: The video is 60 seconds with sections of 5, 40, 10 and 5 seconds.
The results in the walkthrough show the F sharps landing sharp.
success_signal: The same structure and timings as every other demo.
strongest_reason_not_to_build: Nothing to build: it is a test of the demo template itself.
